content.intro: In this lesson, you will work through the this keyword in jquery with a focused jQuery example. The subtopics below preserve the supplied curriculum coverage and connect the API idea to a small browser interface.
content.why_it_matters: This topic is useful because it turns native event-handler this into a repeatable implementation choice. The jQuery function returns a jQuery collection for selections and accepts a callback for DOM-ready execution. A collection is not the same thing as a single native DOM element.
